page.notes: Two parallel columns of index entries, each in the form Cap. | Verf. | Pag. The Daniel and Hoseas heads sit in the right-hand column; the last line "Cap." is a catchword at the lower right. The entry for XXII. in the left column has its page value "5.9" in the Pag. column; some Verf. cells are blank. Some digits in the page numbers are small and uncertain and are transcribed as printed.
